checks.name: Production mode disables public demo and provisions only explicit owner
Registration requires real password and merchant approval
Fictional demo delivery fees cannot authorize direct checkout in a real business workspace
HTTPS browser writes work behind trusted platform proxy and foreign origins fail
Mobile assets retain JavaScript MIME, navigation uses HTML and canonical downloads support GET HEAD and range
Static assets preserve commerce quota and exhausted API requests return structured retry responses
Database, legacy address snapshots, hashed sessions and orders survive server restart
Retired catalog references disappear while existing order snapshots survive
Password changes verify old secret and revoke all sessions
Online SQLite backup preserves account, order and actual payment records consistently
Restored backup and identity keys serve authenticated account, historical order and payment APIs on a separate port
